n737bc7235b.headline: São Paulo mayors formalize appeal at TJ to ease precatórios - Diário do Grande ABC
n737bc7235b.summary: Mayors in São Paulo formalized a proposal to the judiciary aimed at easing precatórios payments to prevent revenue seizures.
n737bc7235b.why: Precatórios are court-ordered government debt payments; easing them can improve municipal fiscal stability and public finances in Brazil.

ne75d06a227.headline: IMF warns of threat to global economy due to collapse of exports in China
ne75d06a227.summary: The International Monetary Fund warns that a decline in China's exports poses a threat to global economic growth.
ne75d06a227.why: China is the world's second-largest economy and a major global exporter; disruptions in its trade flows can significantly impact global supply chains and economic growth.
ne75d06a227.why_moved: The IMF warning highlights risks to global growth from China's export decline, which can reduce demand for commodities and disrupt supply chains, affecting markets worldwide.
